text: The plan targets CIKM 2027 with an 8-month runway (annotation set, baselines, writing); WWW 2027 is abandoned—its Oct 18 deadline leaves only 5 weeks. Alternatives: SIGIR 2027 AP Track, KBS journal (IF≈8.8), and TKDE. CIKM desk-reject traps to avoid: abstract deadline one week early, which freezes the author list; appendix counting toward the 10-page limit; mandatory GenAI Usage Disclosure; and an unfilled EasyChair reviewer nomination. Tier-1 rivals are CRAG, Self-RAG, and MCP-Pyserini (first MCP-based RAG). Proposed title: "Content-Verified Retrieval with Experience-Grounded Credibility for Agentic Knowledge Bases." Benchmark sets A–E: A = 30 docs/11 domains; C (core) = 40+ queries expanding to 100, reporting P@5, R@5, nDCG@5, FPR; D = 15+ Q&A; E = 10 tasks. Annotation requires 3 annotators, Cohen's κ ≥ 0.7, and a frozen public artifact.
